scope: simulation-only verification/usefulness of existing I5/I8; no real EEG, downloads, compression research, or foundation-model training
waveform_normalization: unit discrete L2; source-time contrast coefficient-array norm is 20 nA m, not per-sample amplitude

head_perturbations_at_severity1.sensor_contact_contract: cap rotation and tangential jitter projected onto actual outer sphere; fixed global source positions and orientations

covariance_contract: known common label/head-independent Cs tensor Ct within each condition, formed at fixed nominal full sensor positions, then subset and full-rank CAR coordinates

calibration.global_head_score: max over six fixed montage/noise-shape spatial spectral scores at 4 microV; p||Ws Espace||op with p=20nAm
calibration.global_membership: one scalar score simultaneously controls all predeclared montage/noise/target conditions; high-noise epsilon scales by 4microV/sigma; temporal radius epsilon*kappa*||Wt waveform||
calibration.nominal_scope: fixed nominal sphere before independent calibration; exact simulator-known probe errors, not noisy physical stimulation estimates
calibration.quantile_rule: maximum of n independent calibration scores
calibration.primary_simultaneous_scope: n119, all15 replicate/severity calibration sets, all targets/montages/noise conditions via global membership; confidence at least 1-15*.95^119

physical_information.law: conditional uniform finite ensemble of200 independently drawn check heads, hides head identity; not continuous generator MI
physical_information.numerical_uncertainty: empirical Monte Carlo SE and pointwise Hoeffding95 interval for bounded posterior entropy; ensemble/head approximation not included
physical_information.sufficient_projection: exact fixed-waveform matched temporal projection; use full spatial CAR dimension and exact dot-product finite-mixture likelihood, no singular-value truncation

decoder.selection: train-only standardization; fixed nominal basis; independent validation balanced error outer grids (grid-order ties); MLP epoch/early stopping validation log loss; no check/test selection

abstract.method: exact finite-mixture likelihood in dimension1/2, Gauss-Hermite with declared adaptive numerical refinement; order comparison diagnostic, not rigorous error bound

finite_population_fixture.purpose: declared exact finite acquisition population; true inclusion mass and maximum-score failure probability known, with actual hidden-law MI and partial-mass bounds

publication_gates.mathematical_checks: all constructed support/endpoint/coordinate checks pass; reported numerical comparisons within their explicitly declared integration tolerance
publication_gates.usefulness: report fractions at prespecified descriptive benchmarks without using them as statistical thresholds
publication_gates.originality: independent literature/proof audit; simulation pass does not establish originality
publication_gates.population_scope: simulator law only; no complete-support or real-head guarantee
